caption: The drawing is rendered in pencil on a beige-toned paper and depicts a large, cylindrical mug or tankard with a rounded bottom and a wide, slightly flaring base. The main object, which occupies the center of the composition, is shaded to suggest a metallic surface and bears horizontal bands near the top and base, as well as an ornamental monogram within a decorative scroll motif on its side. The mug features a large, curved handle that attaches near the top and bottom of its body, with a small, raised tab emerging from just below the lower connection. In the upper left corner, there is a rectangular inset showing a detailed, close-up design of the same decorative monogram with scrollwork. In the lower right corner, another smaller rectangular inset displays a side-view outline of the mug showing its profile in simple linework. Both insets, along with the mug, are enclosed in neatly drawn rectangles. At the bottom center, near the main rectangle's edge, is a hand-written name: “Michael J. Fenga.”
title: Silver Mug
